blogPosts.title: Electrical Safety Tips for Queenscliff Homes This Summer
blogPosts.excerpt: Stay safe this summer in Queenscliff with essential electrical safety tips, from managing high loads to protecting against storm damage.
body: Summer in Queenscliff brings increased electrical loads from air conditioners, fans, and holiday lighting. To prevent overloads, avoid plugging multiple high-wattage devices into one outlet. Spread the load across different circuits and consider upgrading your switchboard if frequent trips occur.

Coastal storms in Queenscliff can cause power surges and outages. Use surge protectors for sensitive electronics and ensure your home is equipped with a surge protection device at the main switchboard. Wired By Whitley can install these to safeguard your Queenscliff property during the storm season.

Outdoor electrical safety is crucial during summer. Check that outdoor lighting and extension cords are rated for outdoor use and keep them away from water sources. In Queenscliff's humid climate, inspect cords for wear and tear regularly to avoid hazards.

Teach your family about electrical safety, especially children. Keep appliances away from water, don't touch switches with wet hands, and report any flickering lights or unusual sounds immediately. In Queenscliff, our electricians are available for safety inspections to identify potential risks.
